_comment: Reviewed security audit exceptions. Each entry documents a known vulnerability that has been assessed and accepted with mitigations in place. Review quarterly or when upgrading major dependencies.

accepted.title: Next.js DoS via Image Optimizer remotePatterns
accepted.mitigation: Our remotePatterns config uses explicit hostnames only (no wildcards). The vulnerable code path requires overly permissive patterns with protocol wildcards. Not exploitable in our configuration.

accepted.title: Next.js HTTP request deserialization DoS via insecure RSC
accepted.mitigation: Requires 'insecure' React Server Components usage patterns. Our RSC usage follows Next.js recommended patterns with no user-controlled deserialization of arbitrary payloads. Rate limiting is in place at the infrastructure level.
